name: What maintenance is required for different types of front doors?

mainEntity.name: What maintenance is required for different types of front doors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maintenance varies by door material. Steel doors typically require minimal maintenance, mainly cleaning and occasional touch-ups for scratches to prevent rust. Fiberglass doors are also low-maintenance, needing only regular cleaning and possibly re-staining or repainting after many years. Wood doors, while beautiful, require the most maintenance, including periodic cleaning, sanding, re-staining or repainting, and sealing to protect against warping, cracking, and sun damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maintenance depends on the door material: steel needs minimal care, fiberglass is low-maintenance, and wood requires regular cleaning, staining, and sealing to prevent damage.
